name: session
description: Session modes for the main Claude Code session, one user-invocable skill per mode: forks (main session + fork subagents, a waiter agent for long waits), pipeline (forks plus a staged pipeline: ledger, decision contract, verification harness, implementation, closure check, report, cost ledger), codex (codex models luna/terra/sol/astra on pipeline stages, alone or paired), ask (questions without blocking), and the unstable worker pool (pool-workflow, pool, pool-stop). README.md holds the whole reference: cache facts, compact prices, measurements.
